blocks.name: Master Budget
blocks.definition:
how to prepare the following budgets:
– budgeted statement of profit or loss
– budgeted statement of financial position

blocks.text: How to prepare a master budget?

blocks.md:
- The master budget includes **two forecasted financial statements**:

  - Budgeted statement of profit and loss
  - Budgeted statement of financial position
- Use the other budgets to prepare the master budgets
